data.one_liner: Platform‑independent HTTP client for browser, console and curl with SOCKS proxy support
data.what_it_does: Provides a single Client API that works on web, mobile, desktop and console. It can use the browser fetch API, a console implementation or curl for SOCKS proxies. The API mimics the package:http Client interface.
use_when: Need a single HTTP client that works across all Dart platforms
Want to use curl for SOCKS proxy support
Building a library that should be platform‑agnostic
Need a lightweight alternative to dio for simple requests
avoid_when: Already using dio or http for all platforms
Require advanced features like interceptors, multipart, or reactive streams
strengths: Supports browser, console, and curl with SOCKS proxy
Simple drop‑in replacement for package:http Client
weaknesses: Limited feature set compared to dio (no interceptors, multipart, etc.)
No built‑in retry or timeout configuration beyond basic options
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import the desired implementation (console.dart, browser.dart, or http_client.dart). No build_runner or permissions required.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard HTTP client with broad community support

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Feature‑rich client with interceptors, transformers, and advanced request handling
